jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Senior Software Engineer Altera Institute Gurugram, Haryana, India 5 hours ago 168 applicants See who Altera Institute has hired for this role Apply Save Report this job Direct message the job poster from Altera Institute Aparna Upadhyay Aparna Upadhyay Senior Software Engineer (SDE II) || Altera Institute - Digiaccel Learning At Digiaccel Learning and Altera Institute, we are on a mission to redefine management education for the digital and AI-first world. We are building technology that powers transformative learning experiences for thousands of learners across India. From learner journeys and assessments to AI-enabled learning experiences and internal platforms, our engineering team plays a critical role in shaping the future of education. As a Senior Software Engineer II (SDE II), you will be responsible for designing, building, and scaling high-performance web applications that deliver exceptional user experiences. You will work across the full technology stack, collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Business teams, and take ownership of key product initiatives from ideation to deployment. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex engineering problems, writing clean and scalable code, and building products that create meaningful impact. Key Responsibilities Full Stack Development & Product Engineering Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js, Nest.js). Build reusable, modular, and high-quality components that enhance application performance and maintainability. Translate business requirements and product specifications into elegant technical solutions. Own features end-to-end—from technical design and development to deployment and post-release monitoring. Engineering Excellence & Architecture Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code while adhering to engineering best practices and coding standards. Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to technical design decisions that improve scalability and reliability. Conduct code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and help maintain a high engineering quality bar across the team. Continuously improve application performance, security, and overall system reliability. Collaboration & Cross-Functional Execution Work closely with Product Managers, Designers, and fellow Engineers to define, prioritize, and deliver product features. Collaborate with QA teams to ensure high-quality releases through effective testing and validation. Support technical discussions, sprint planning, and estimation activities within the engineering team. Mentor junior developers and contribute to fostering a collaborative engineering culture. Performance Optimization & Problem Solving Identify bottlenecks and optimize applications for speed, scalability, and responsiveness. Troubleshoot production issues, debug complex technical problems, and implement sustainable solutions. Monitor application health and proactively improve system stability and user experience. Quality, Testing & Continuous Improvement Develop and maintain unit, integration, and functional tests to ensure application reliability. Maintain comprehensive technical documentation for applications, APIs, and engineering processes. Stay updated with emerging technologies, frameworks, and industry best practices, driving continuous improvements within the engineering team. What We're Looking For 3-5 years of experience in full-stack software development using the MERN stack. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Strong proficiency in MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, NestJS and Node.js. Experience with modern JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, and responsive web development Experience with Git and collaborative software development workflows. Exposure to Docker, cloud platforms (AWS preferred), CI/CD pipelines, or containerized deployments is desirable. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with a focus on delivering scalable solutions. Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills. High ownership mindset with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Why Join Us? Build Products That Matter - Create technology that impacts the learning journeys and careers of thousands of professionals. Engineering with Ownership - Work on challenging product problems where your ideas and technical decisions have meaningful influence. High-Growth Environment - Be part of a fast-scaling organization that values innovation, speed, and engineering excellence. Continuous Learning - Work alongside experienced product and engineering leaders while continuously expanding your technical expertise. Collaborative Culture - Join a team that believes in transparency, ownership, intellectual honesty, and continuous improvement. About the Company Digiaccel Learning is a Gurgaon headquartered education company that is redefining the gold standard of management education for the digital and AI first world. By doing so, it is building the next generation of business leaders in the country. The mission of the company is to build employability through education. Education is a hard and important problem to solve for. India needs to double its higher education infrastructure in order to serve its large demographic of youth. Within what exists, quality is a large problem with studies reporting that 50% of Indian graduates are unemployable. Add to this the shift inthe skills ecosystemat the workplace with AI and digitization. All of this has led to a higher-education infrastructure that is unable to serve the aspirations of its students. So, you have MBA studentsfrom legacy institutes who are unplacedand professionals who are struggling to level up in their careers because they don’t have the skills to progress. The secret sauce at the company is its instructional design, a learner centric ethos and a bar for quality that runs across touchpoints. This reflects in a 80%+ NPS across all programs since inception. Digiaccel Learning is VC backed and has CXOs and Founders of some of India’s top digital commerce companies as it’s investors. We are looking for smart passionate folks to join us in this mission of building a better, smarter and more outcome oriented education system. We are a youngcompany and each role has the abilityto make a largeimpact. We can assure of a very talent dense,intellectually honest, actionoriented and collaborative environment. We are sure that you will join for the opportunity and stay for the impact of seeing your work help thousands of others. Save Report this job About The Role We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer with a strong foundation in enterprise application development, low-latency services, and cloud-native engineering. The ideal candidate combines hands-on coding ability across backend and frontend technologies with a product mindset, helping build resilient, scalable, and secure features across State Street’s platform ecosystem. As a Senior Associate, you will work closely with senior engineers, architects, and product teams to design, develop, test, and support modern applications and services. This role is well suited for engineers who are eager to deepen their experience in full-stack development, CI/CD, cloud deployment, and enterprise-grade software delivery in a highly collaborative environment. Key Responsibilities Build and maintain application features across the full stack, including backend services in Python and/or Java and frontend components using React and/or Angular. Contribute to the design, development, testing, and deployment of scalable and secure enterprise applications. Develop and integrate RESTful APIs, service endpoints, and backend business logic to support product and platform capabilities. Build responsive, reusable, and user-friendly frontend components aligned with UX and design standards. Support development and deployment of services on cloud-native infrastructure, including AWS and/or Azure environments. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated build and deployment processes, and test automation to support reliable releases. Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, technical design discussions, and pod ceremonies to improve engineering quality and delivery effectiveness. Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve defects across frontend, backend, integration, and deployment layers. Collaborate with product owners, QA engineers, architects, and peer developers to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Ensure code quality through adherence to engineering standards, secure coding practices, documentation, and testing best practices. Support application monitoring, logging, and operational readiness to help maintain platform stability and performance. Learn and apply enterprise patterns for microservices, cloud-native delivery, observability, and scalable software design. Contribute to ongoing improvements in developer experience, performance optimization, and maintainability of platform components. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 0–7 years of experience in software engineering or full-stack application development. Working knowledge of Python or Java for backend development. Experience with at least one modern frontend framework such as React or Angular. Understanding of REST API design, web services, and integration patterns. Familiarity with relational and/or NoSQL databases, including basic data modeling and query concepts. Exposure to cloud-native development on AWS and/or Azure. Familiarity with Git, version control workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing practices. Basic understanding of microservices architecture, containerization, and software development lifecycle practices. Experience with Docker and basic familiarity with Kubernetes. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to debug issues across multiple layers of the application stack. Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented, agile engineering environment. Good written and verbal communication skills. Knowledge of observability tools, logging, monitoring, and alerting practices. Coursework, certifications, or project experience involving GenAI/LLM-powered applications is a plus. About State Street Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success. We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Experience with Docker, Linux, cloud platforms, or desktop engineering tools. Familiarity with real-time systems, hardware-in-the-loop testing, or system simulation.
